verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents several export paths of its own: CSV downloads from analytics tables, one-click case information download, a Reports History export of case data including comments, and APIs for listing and fetching cases for data syncing. None of these is a documented complete-account export, though. Only the analytics export is explicitly in an open format (CSV), and nothing covers bulk retrieval of attachments or CRM data. Missing for 10: a documented full-account/all-data export, open formats confirmed for case and report exports, bulk attachment and CRM export, offboarding/exit guidance, and independent corroboration.
